import odoolib, inspect
c = odoolib.get_connection()
print('conn attrs', [x for x in dir(c) if not x.startswith('_')])
print('uid', getattr(c,'user_id',None))
print('db', getattr(c,'database',None))
print('get_model', inspect.signature(c.get_model))
for model, fields in [('sale.order',['name','state','partner_id','date_order','commitment_date','amount_total']),('mrp.production',['name','state','product_id','product_qty','origin']),('purchase.order',['name','state','partner_id','date_order','origin']),('mail.message',['date','subject','body','model','res_id'])]:
    try:
        m=c.get_model(model)
        print('MODEL',model,'methods',[x for x in dir(m) if x in ['search','read','search_read','create','write','fields_get']])
        ids=m.search([], limit=50, order='id desc')
        print('IDS',ids)
        if ids: print('ROWS',m.read(ids, fields))
    except Exception as e: print('ERROR',model,type(e).__name__,str(e))
